title: fix(mcp): the refusal-reasons relay withholds only the security gate's own refusal
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu3zQ2AqeghSGpv6Q7VEPDyQ)_

Fixes #37512

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化：智能体通过 MCP 遇到应用自己按“无权限”声明的多原因拒绝时，现在也能完整拿到每条原因再转告用户；平台安全检查本身的拒绝仍然什么都不多给。
- 为什么做：这是上一轮“多原因拒绝完整转告智能体”审核留下的跟进项；同一个调用者走 REST 接口早已拿到这些原因，MCP 却少给了。
- 出错会怎样：只影响应用声明为“无权限”的多原因拒绝，智能体多看到一段原因文字；安全检查的内部授权信息在任何路径上都不读取，可以直接撤回。
- 要你做什么：无。

## What changes

`packages/mcp/src/mcp-http-tools.ts` only, plus the tests and one changeset.

- **S1, the guard's reach (narrowed to the gate's own refusal).** `withRefusalReasonsRelay` now withholds the relay block on a served `PERMISSION_DENIED` with no `declaredCode`: the security gate's own refusal. A listed refusal an app's catalogue declared at `403` under its own code is served as `PERMISSION_DENIED` with that code in `declaredCode` (the doors' demotion of an unregistered code) and now gets the block. `errorResultFromThrown`'s `PERMISSION_DENIED` arm now passes through the same function, so `run_action` / `resume_run` reach it too; that arm still serves no `details` (the #23529 / #7450 withholding is unchanged). The relay reads only `refusals` and `userMessage`, never `details`, so the gate's `positions` / `permissionSets` reach it on no path.
- **Parity, measured, not argued.** For the same 403 app-code throw, both REST doors' own readers serve the same caller every relayed line as `details.refusals`: `mapDataError` (what the `/data` routes answer with) and `actionsDoorAnswerOf` (what `/actions` answers with, its `userMessage` uncut, closing line included). The dispatcher's withholding arm keys on `isPermissionDeniedError`, which reads `false` for that throw (scratch probe against `plugin-security`'s source: app-at-403 `false`, gate-shaped `true`). So MCP serves nothing REST does not serve the same caller. MCP stays stricter than REST in two places, both left alone: the gate's own literal `PERMISSION_DENIED` carrying a list (REST `/data` would attach it), and `details` on `run_action` for the demoted 403.
- **S2, the 5xx arm.** Pinned (a listed throw at 503 on `run_action` and `resume_run`, the only renderers that reach the relay on a fault; on the record tools a declared 5xx never reaches the envelope path). The jsdoc reason is corrected: the doors do still serve `userMessage` on a declared 5xx; the block is withheld because a refusal catalogue declares only a 4xx (`declaredRefusalEntrySchema`), so a listed throw at a 5xx is no catalogue refusal.
- **S3, `delete_records` per-row refusals: declared needless, with a pin.** Measured: the per-row group's `reason` is NOT cut. The catalogue throws a coded `SandboxError` whose caller sentence (`innerMessage`) is the same text as `userMessage` (`hook-refusal-catalogue.ts`, both set to `answer.message`), and `rowRefusalOf` reads a coded throw's own sentence, never the door's 500-character cut. So each group already names every line whole, in order, closing line last. No relay block is added, so the grouping shape is untouched; `rowRefusalOf`'s jsdoc says why, and a pin holds a list over 500 characters.
- **N3.** `REFUSAL_REASONS_RELAY_LEAD` now reads `Tell the user every line below, whole and in this order, in place of userMessage:` (true on both doors; `/actions` never cuts).

## Tests

`packages/mcp/src/mcp-refusal-reasons.test.ts` (the card's harness file; new top-level `describe` blocks), 17 new cases, all through the real HTTP `/mcp` transport:

- S1: on each of the five write/action tools, a listed 403 app-code refusal answers two blocks, `content[0]` is `{ code: PERMISSION_DENIED, declaredCode, status: 403 }` with no `details`, `content[1]` is the relay. Parity case: `mapDataError` and `actionsDoorAnswerOf` on the same throw serve `details.refusals` equal to the lines. Control: a gate-shaped throw (`PermissionDeniedError`, literal code, `details.positions` / `permissionSets`) answers one block on every tool, no `declaredCode`, and none of its details' text.
- S2: a listed throw at 503 on `run_action` and `resume_run` answers one block, status 503, no `details`.
- N1: `query_records`, `aggregate_records`, `get_record`, `get_record_context` and the `delete_records` outer catch each answer the relay, `content[0]` equal to the same throw without a list; `query_records` with an unknown field keeps `notRecorded` / `ifNotRecorded` beside the envelope and the relay after it.
- N2: a `FLOW_FAILED` throw that is also listed answers three blocks in order: envelope, flow sentence, relay.
- S3: `delete_records` over two rows refused by a six-line list (over 500 characters): one group, `reason` equal to the whole text, its lines the listed lines then the closing line; one content block.
- The double gained an `asCatalogue` option (caller sentence = `userMessage`, the catalogue's real shape); the #37416 cases keep their old double unchanged.

<details><summary>Package suite, typecheck, ablations (head 4682eb8456)</summary>

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/mcp typecheck && pnpm --filter @objectstack/mcp exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2`, under the verify lock: `VERDICT command-exit 0`; Test Files 86 passed (86), Tests 1557 passed (1557) (1540 on main + 17); `check:test-typecheck: OK`.
- Ablation S1 (`node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, anchor `PERMISSION_DENIED && served.declaredCode === undefined)` to the bare code check; blob 0754deea to 5fe5f300): 5 failed / 26 passed, the five per-tool 403 cases. Restored: blob equals HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty. (A first attempt with a replacement that already occurred in the file was refused by the tool before any run: counted 5 to 5; re-run with a distinct marker.)
- Ablation S2 (the `isServerFault` guard deleted; blob to fa47a2ee): 2 failed / 29 passed, the two 503 cases. Restored, `git diff HEAD` empty.
- Ablation S1 on `/actions` (the `PERMISSION_DENIED` arm back to `codedErrorResult(envelope)`; blob to 4f91d8a8): 2 failed / 29 passed, the `run_action` / `resume_run` 403 cases. Restored, `git diff HEAD` empty.
- The tests import `src/` relatively, so no rebuild was needed for the ablations.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- Premise corrections, measured: S2's "a catalogue entry may declare a 5xx status" does not hold at authoring (`declaredRefusalEntrySchema` takes 400 to 499; the hook and action schema tests refuse 500 / 503); the arm is defence for a hand-built listed throw. S3's "keeps the cut sentence" does not hold for the catalogue's throw (see What changes); it held only for the #37416 test double, whose caller sentence is the bare code.
- Not changed: `run_action` / `resume_run` still serve no `details` on any `PERMISSION_DENIED`, including the demoted 403, while REST `/actions` serves its `details.refusals`. The relay block now carries those lines, so nothing an agent needs is missing; widening `details` there is outside this card.
- L2: the diff narrows a permission-keyed withholding guard, so `Security-touching` reads yes for the reviewer; no exposure found (the relay reads no `details`).

## Verification

<details><summary>Derived gates (67), on 4682eb8456</summary>

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` (3 paths vs merge base 54ea3c8c3): 67 derived; 66 exit 0. One NOT MEASURED: `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads` exit 3 (PREREQUISITE NOT MET: needs the whole workspace built; CI Build Core runs it).
- `--ran` reconciliation with exit codes recorded: 67 accounted, 66 run, 1 NOT-MEASURED (derived from the recorded exit 3), 0 UNRUN.
- `node scripts/pm/overlap-check.mjs`: clean against origin/main and #37436.

</details>

CI check-runs are the authority for every family.

Two-minute check: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/mcp exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/mcp-refusal-reasons.test.ts`. Expect 31 passed.

Read first: `withRefusalReasonsRelay` (the narrowed guard and its jsdoc), the `PERMISSION_DENIED` arm of `errorResultFromThrown`, and the parity case in the test file.
